notes: Seeded from a research pass on 12 Oct 2026. Each venue was confirmed open via a dated 2026 listing or 2026 news (see status_evidence).
Official website URLs were not all fetched individually; the venue profiler should confirm them on its first run.
Scouts may read this file but must not edit it. Suggested changes go in the run report for a human to apply.
A venue with no_primary_listing: true has no venue or ticket page online; the verifier may publish its events on aggregator evidence alone.

Platform 'domains' are enforced by scripts/validate.py and scripts/check_quote.py: do-not-use and do-not-scrape domains are never fetched or accepted as evidence; discovery-only domains can never be labelled primary.
13 Oct 2026: DJ-coverage pass added 19 venues (mostly fringe/outer), DICE's 'DJ in London' browse page for daily discovery, and marked Songkick, EventsList (republishes RA), Shotgun (429) do-not-use.

14 Oct 2026: nights & music is now covered by two scouts working from this one registry: the club & DJ nights scout (scout-nights-clubs: club-night, dj-bar, queer-party) and the gigs & live music scout (scout-nights-gigs: gig, jazz, folk-acoustic, karaoke, open-mic, in-store, cabaret-drag, festival, other). Between them they read at most 20 pages per website per run, at most 12 each, except dice.fm, split 14 (clubs) and 6 (gigs).

zones.core: E2 postcode or within about 1km of Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.fringe: Up to about a 20-minute walk (1.6km) from Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.outer: Further out (Dalston, Hackney Central, Hackney Wick, west Shoreditch, Clapton). Scanned every run by both nights scouts: up to 15 standout club or DJ nights (club & DJ nights scout) and up to 10 standout gigs or other live music (gigs & live music scout). All flagged worth_the_trip.

platforms.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
platforms.why: No public API. Terms 4.4 ban automated extraction without written permission; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot. Do not fetch, do not use third-party RA scrapers.

platforms.name: DICE
platforms.how: Venue pages (dice.fm/venue/<slug>) carry up to ~30 events in JSON-LD with ISO dates; best primary source found. Browse pages give about 20 London-wide events (title, 'Fri 16 Oct' with no year, venue, price) with no addresses and no paging in the text; use them to spot venues, then read venue/event pages. Some venues' JSON-LD startDate is door time (Ridley Road: always 18:00).

browse_urls.what_it_shows: 'DJ in London': ~20 soonest DJ events, title/day-date/venue/price as text. Best single daily DJ discovery page.
Genre sub-page (also /disco, /techno and ~100 other genre slugs).
Popular London events, all types; little DJ value.

platforms.name: Ticket Tailor
platforms.how: Box-office pages as before. Discovery hub is global and uncurated - no London/DJ filter in text.

browse_urls.what_it_shows: Worldwide sample of events by category; no London filter. Not useful.

platforms.name: Skiddle
platforms.how: Public event and venue pages are readable (dates, postcodes): read them with page_text.py. API search also possible once SKIDDLE_API_KEY is set (non-commercial unless Skiddle agrees in writing). Public pages are readable and robots-allowed: venue pages (skiddle.com/whats-on/London/<Venue-Name>/) and listing pages embed JSON-LD events with ISO dates, venue address and postcode. Suggest allowing public-page reads alongside the pending API.
platforms.blocker: Free key is non-commercial unless Skiddle approves in writing. Apply and confirm before relying on it.

browse_urls.what_it_shows: 'Club Nights in London': 24 events per page in JSON-LD with dates, venue and postcode (filterable by E1/E2/E8...). London-wide, few East London results.
All London events, JSON-LD; not DJ-specific.

platforms.name: Eventbrite
platforms.how: Location search was shut off in 2020. Only list events by organiser or venue id stored on a venue below. Key in env EVENTBRITE_TOKEN.

platforms.name: OutSavvy
platforms.how: Search/explore page is readable text with event name, full date ('Tuesday 13th October 2026'), venue and price. Category filter in the query string is ignored by the text render, so expect all LGBTQ+ event types.

browse_urls.what_it_shows: 'Events Near London' with names, full dates, venues, prices; mixed categories.

platforms.name: Songkick
platforms.how: CHANGE: songkick.com robots.txt now has 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /'; page_text refuses every Songkick URL tested, including registry venue pages. All Songkick listings in nights-music.json are now unreadable.
platforms.why: Since October 2026 Songkick's robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot entirely. Do not fetch.

platforms.name: ma.to
platforms.how: Venue pages (ma.to/venue/<slug>) list up to 5 upcoming events in JSON-LD with ISO dates and offsets; visible text has titles but no dates. Event pages (ma.to/event/...) carry full JSON-LD and an organizer.url that reveals venue slugs. Images are pulled from Instagram posts, so treat as leads only. robots.txt allows all except /api/ and /admin/.

browse_urls.what_it_shows: 'What's Happening Today in London': titles and venues, London-wide, no dates, no JSON-LD. Weak.
